cli-aarch64-musl.comment: PLAN §4.1 row 3: CLI only, no web/acme/update. --no-default-features --features module-hosts,module-resolver,module-chrony,module-mounts,module-nfs,module-samba,module-dhcp,module-network,init-systemd, aarch64-unknown-linux-musl, release, stripped. Budget <= 3 MiB (3145728 bytes). Measured via `cargo zigbuild --release -p detent --target aarch64-unknown-linux-musl --no-default-features --features module-hosts,module-resolver,module-chrony,module-mounts,module-nfs,module-samba,module-dhcp,module-network,init-systemd` on 2026-09-10. This row first had to name crypto-ring as well, because main.rs demanded a rustls provider even with `web` off; that compile_error is now gated on `web`, and the binary is byte-identical either way (1704952), which is what showed the feature was a no-op here.
